exposure: Vaginal isosorbide mononitrate (IMN) plus oral hydration
Oral hydration plus placebo vaginal tablet
outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: The study involved 210 singleton pregnancies at >28 gestational weeks complicated by isolated oligohydramnios.
finding: The study found that vaginal isosorbide mononitrate plus oral hydration led to a more significant improvement in amniotic fluid volume and pregnancy outcomes compared to oral hydration alone in pregnancies with isolated oligohydramnios.
birth_weight: Not mentioned, but low birth weight was measured as an outcome
